G2.note: All 9 refactor steps done: domain/data/guard/session index.ts barrels added and every cross-subdirectory deep import repointed through them (steps 1-4); six discriminant unions extracted to as-const object enums - LoginCardStateKind, LoginResultOutcome, SessionStatus, SessionShadowStatus, LookupOutcomeKind, SessionUnreadableReason (steps 5-9). Claude-1.desc: New const-enums (LoginResultOutcome, LoginCardStateKind, SessionStatus, SessionUnreadableReason, SessionShadowStatus, LookupOutcomeKind) were inlined into existing multi-export files instead of getting their own dedicated file per typescript-coding's one-symbol-per-file rule and the repo's own SignInOutcome precedent. Pre-existing multi-export files made worse, not introduced from clean. No runtime/compile effect.
Claude-1.disposition: accepted: user's decision - each enum stays colocated with the type/function that uses it as a discriminant (tightly-coupled state-machine modules, not standalone shared taxonomies like SignInOutcome); splitting into 5 more single-purpose files would fragment small, closely-related declarations for no readability gain

Codex-1.desc: SessionUnreadableReason exported despite AC6's single-file scope promise - nothing outside readSession.ts consumed it, expanding module surface unnecessarily.
Codex-1.disposition: fixed: removed export from SessionUnreadableReason's const and type declarations in readSession.ts - nothing outside the file consumed it, and it was never re-exported from session/index.ts; tsc/lint/vitest reconfirmed green

Codex-2.desc: 9 step evidence .txt logs have a trailing blank line git diff --check flags; committed patch fails git whitespace validation, no runtime effect.
Codex-2.disposition: accepted: user's decision - trailing newline in captured command-output evidence logs, no effect on content/correctness; loop convention treats registered evidence as immutable, so recapturing under new filenames for a whitespace nit is not worth the churn
